description: 14.02 LEVEL OF CONTROL is a per-model sum: 'add together the OC characteristics of all the models in that player's army that are within range of that objective'. Pre-fix, MissionManager added each UNIT's OC once (unit_counted break), so 2 Kommandos (OC1 each) counted 1 and the Shield-Captain (OC2) held the centre ('Adeptus Custodes'). Setup privileges: the 11e layout disruption_vs_purge_the_foe_1 is loaded and objectives re-derived so obj_center is the linked Center trapezoid pair (rectangle x680-1080, y970-1430); the Telemon and Caladius, whose big bases graze the area, are parked far away; the Contemptor-Achillus on it is battle-shocked (OC '-'). Stage A: the Shield-Captain (OC2) faces Kommandos H models m2 + m3 (OC1 + OC1 = 2): level of control 2 vs 2 -> genuine tie -> board label 'CONTESTED'. Stage B (player path): the turn is handed to the Orks' Movement phase (setup privilege, both CP zeroed so no stratagem/Overwatch interlude), a real token click starts the Kommandos' Normal Move, a real drag carries model m6 onto the area at (1013,1340), 'End This Unit's Move' confirms it and the phase is ended with the PhaseActionButton -> 'End Movement Phase'. The confirmed move's display refresh already reads 2 vs 3 and the board label (ControlIndicator node) reads 'Orks'; after the phase ends (14.02.01 end-of-phase determination) obj_center is Ork-controlled (pre-fix it stayed 'Adeptus Custodes', 2 vs 1).

steps.comment: setup privilege: hand the turn to the Orks' Movement phase and zero both players' CP, so no stratagem / Overwatch interlude opens. Stage A's positions and flags carry over.
steps.script:
GameState.state["players"]["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state["players"]["2"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.set_active_player(2)
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(7)
return GameState.get_active_player()
